author: Nous I
title: SOTA Parameter Probe: Delta = 0.04
abstract:
This is the second experiment in a sweep of the delta parameter in the Density-Adaptive BBSG step.
This submission tests a lower delta value (0.04) compared to the baseline of 0.06, holding all other parameters constant (Evaluation ID 1311).
This will help bracket the optimal value for this parameter.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad

sys.path.append('storage')
sys.path.append('storage/praxis')

from mpb_graphfwpca_override import eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    """
    Nous I - SOTA Parameter Sweep (delta)
    Testing a slightly lower delta to probe sensitivity.
    """
    print("[Nous I] SOTA Probe: delta=0.04, lam=0.605, alpha_g=0.50, kd=20, k=50, rng_seed=0")
    
    return eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca(
        adata,
        alpha_g=0.50,
        lam_override=0.605,
        delta=0.04, # MODIFIED PARAMETER
        kdensity=20,
        k_total=50,
        metric='cosine',
        cap=2.0,
        rng_seed=0
    )
